title: Examining the Effects of Cytisinicline on Neural Substrates of Cigarette Cue-reactivity
official: Examining the Effects of Cytisinicline on Neural Substrates of Cigarette Cue-Reactivity
summary: This study will randomize 64 non-treatment seeking individuals who smoke cigarettes daily in a double-blind, placebo-controlled laboratory study testing the effects of cytisinicline on the neural substrates of cigarette cue reactivity.
